page.topic: Modular/prefabricated data centers for AI factories
target_prompts: Why are prefabricated modular data centers needed for AI factories?
What rack power densities do AI data centers require?
What are the benefits of prefabricated UPS and switchgear skids?
What is an AI IT pod and how is it deployed?
Why were early containerized modular data centers unpopular?
How does prefabrication address skilled-labor shortages?

criteria.rationale: Opens with author biography; the thesis (prefab is a necessity) only appears in the final section. Title carries the topic phrase but no early answer, no section answers, no summary.
No attributed statistics, standards, quotes or first-party data; named author with stated experience only.
Genuine 30-year field perspective and a clear thesis, but no framework, no SE data, no 'what to do' guidance.
Some density numbers but benefits are adjectives ('Fewer risks'), 'innovative' claims, CDU undefined; 0.71 facts/100w.
Seed and most sub-questions covered; no quantified benefit of prefab (time/cost) for an Education reader.
Generic headings ('A slow start'), long history paragraph, context-dependent openers ('These criteria', 'All this').
H1 ends in a pop-culture pun; H2s partly descriptive, none question-shaped. Titles consistent across H1/SEO title/meta.
Expert voice, fair stick-built vs prefab contrast, no CTAs; no current limitations of prefab.
Pod named three ways; third-party models named; no descriptive next-step links.
Depth and language fit the stage; CTA names no specific SE asset (link check N/A per R6).
Visible date, current facts; no visible 'Updated' label (template).
